title: Clinica Suiza Lab
description:
Healthcare · Peru
Full data leak: 2026-11-11 11:25 UTC
A comprehensive healthcare data set was acquired from Clinica Suiza Lab, a Peruvian clinic and laboratory group. The material includes the full patient register with identity documentation, clinical histories, laboratory results, and diagnostic imaging for a large number of individuals including minors, together with staff and physician records and payroll data.
